headline: Library Phase 2B renovation, $1,418,117, reviewed as top priority for a warrant article; Children's Room plans also discussed.
summary: Library staff reviewed proposed capital projects. The Phase 2B renovation, set for FY2028, includes roof, boiler, and humidity work. The Children's Room renovation, aimed mainly at ADA compliance, would cost $306,984 over five fiscal years starting in FY2027, and a $1.6 million one-room addition was also presented.

decision_evidence.quote: Councilor Paul made a motion to approve the August 11, 2026, meeting minutes as presented. Mr. Verani seconded the motion. The motion carried 3-0-0.
